persistence.note: A Traffic simulation crossed cursor wrap, saved, restored into a fresh Simulation and retained checksum parity for 80 more ticks. The default population determinism and save fixture also passed.

graphs.note: The integer visit budget and saved cursor operate on a recurring population; they have no authored node or edge representation.

performance.note: An optimized macOS run scanned ten million scheduled indices across 10000 ticks for 200000 entities at the 1000-visit cap in 0.0443 seconds. The pure planner and cursor use no dynamic allocations. Process peak RSS was 1294336 bytes. This is the scheduling overhead; traffic decisions have their own costs.
